t: This was the site of The Mud Soldier, a mud sculpture installed in Trafalgar Square in 2017. It was an artwork by Damian and Killian Van Der Velden, commissioned to mark the hundredth anniversary of the Battle of Passchendaele. Damian van der Velden is a Dutch painter, born in 1973. A figure made of mud is a fitting way to recall a battle remembered for its mud. It was a temporary display, so what you see now is the square without it.
